title: leucanthemum coronopifolium subsp. ceratophylloides
intro: Leucanthemum coronopifolium subsp. ceratophylloides, commonly known as Mountain Daisy, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family, characterized by its daisy-like flowers and feathery leaves. It has been used in traditional medicine to support health, offering various benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and the treatment of respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Daisy include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and exhibit antioxidant properties, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. Bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
